trigger: Run only if lambda_logcurv=1e-5 retains objective-equivalent stationary functional ambiguity.

objective_family.regularizer: dense origin-anchored dimensionless squared curvature of log(F_NP)

selection.rule: Select the weakest strength satisfying every gate for all objective-equivalent endpoints; refine geometrically between the last failing and first passing strength if needed.
selection.stationarity: Persisted endpoint must pass the declared gradient/stopping audit or a same-objective continuation drift test.
selection.uncertainty_semantics: Experimental replicas are a conditional 68% interval; residual local-start/model spread is a separately labeled nonprobabilistic envelope.
